item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Time perspective and health risk behaviors in adolescence (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

The project aims to investigate the risk and protective factors underlying health-risk behaviors during adolescence. The study focuses on the role of time perspective and self-regulation processes in dysfunctional eating behaviors and the problematic use of alcohol and other substances. Its objective is to contribute to the development of scientific knowledge that can support the design of targeted prevention and well-being promotion interventions. The research includes a systematic review of the scientific literature aimed at identifying the main temporal and emotional-motivational predictors of health-risk behaviors in adolescence. item.description:

Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Cesena
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

Title of the project: “Characterizing individual differences in human sign-trackers and goal-trackers” - The research project aims to advance the characterization of sign-tracking and goal-tracking phenomena in humans, with particular emphasis on their measurement and interpretation within translational research on motivational processes and incentive salience attribution. Activities will focus on improving the quality, reliability, and validity of the tools used to identify individual phenotypic profiles, with specific attention to behavioral indicators derived from Pavlovian conditioning paradigms. Particular interest will be devoted to the development of shared procedures and criteria…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: The aesthetics of food between sensibility, sacredness, rituality and art (SC. GASTRONOMICHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 23:59
Institution: SC. GASTRONOMICHE, Bra, Loc. Pollenzo
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-04 Estetica e filosofia dei linguaggi

The research fellow will investigate the relationship between creative skill, particularly in pastry-making, bread-making and fermentation, and taste experiences, analysing the relationships between the aesthetics and poetics of gastronomic craft and art. The project will also address the ethical and socio-political implications of gastronomic aesthetics in light of everyday aesthetics and somaesthetics.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: NATPRED: Naturalistic Predictions: How our brain anticipates the future in a dynamic world (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

We recently developed a new approach in the lab that combines MEG recordings of participants observing naturalistic dynamic input (e.g., movies), with dynamic representational similarity analysis (dRSA) to quantify both the strength and the millisecond-precision latency of neural representations of naturalistic dynamic input, across hierarchical levels of stimulus complexity (from perceptual-to-conceptual). See [4,5] for relevant previous research from the lab.
